name: stock-exchange
author: Takaro
description: A stock market that cannot print money. Some stocks move with real server activity (monster kills, player deaths, players online, teleports), others move at random. Prices are pulled back to a base price, stay between a floor and a ceiling and move at most a set percent per update. Every trade pays a fee into a pool that is paid back as dividends to shareholders, with a bonus for long holders. Sell lock after buying, max shares per player, news only after a move.
summary: Stock market tied to server activity, with fees, dividends from the fee pool, sell lock and safe price limits.

stocks.title: Stocks

id.title: Ticker
id.description: Short code players type, e.g. DEF. One word, letters and digits. Not case sensitive.

driver.title: Price driver
driver.description: What moves the price besides random noise. kills = entity/monster kills, deaths = player deaths, players = players online, travel = teleport commands, random = noise only.

basePrice.title: Base price
basePrice.description: Normal price. The price is pulled back here and the floor/ceiling are a percent of it.

volatilityPercent.title: Volatility (%)
volatilityPercent.description: Biggest random move per update, in percent.

stocks.description: The listed stocks. Changes apply at once. A removed stock can still be sold at its last price but not bought.

maxMovePercent.title: Max move per update (%)
maxMovePercent.description: A price never moves more than this percent in one update.

reversionPercent.title: Pull back to base (%)
reversionPercent.description: Each update closes this percent of the gap between the price and its base price. Stops prices from running away.

signalStrengthPercent.title: Signal strength (%)
signalStrengthPercent.description: How hard server activity moves signal stocks. Activity at double the usual level moves the price up by this percent (before the max move cap).

floorPercent.title: Price floor (% of base)
floorPercent.description: Lowest price, as a percent of the base price. Never below 1.

ceilingPercent.title: Price ceiling (% of base)
ceilingPercent.description: Highest price, as a percent of the base price.

feePercent.title: Trade fee (%)
feePercent.description: Fee on every buy and every sell, in percent of the trade value. Rounded up. 0 = no percent fee.

minFee.title: Minimum fee
minFee.description: Smallest fee per trade. 0 allowed (then a 0% fee means free trading).

sellLockMinutes.title: Sell lock after buying (minutes)
sellLockMinutes.description: After a buy, that stock cannot be sold for this long. 0 = no lock.

maxSharesPerStock.title: Max shares per stock
maxSharesPerStock.description: Most shares of one stock a player may hold. The STOCK_MAX_SHARES permission count overrides it.

newsMinMovePercent.title: News threshold (%)
newsMinMovePercent.description: After an update, a news line is broadcast for stocks that moved at least this percent. 0 = no news.

dividendPayoutPercent.title: Dividend payout (% of pool)
dividendPayoutPercent.description: Share of the fee pool paid to shareholders on each dividend run. The rest stays in the pool.

holdStreakDays.title: Hold streak (days)
holdStreakDays.description: A holding kept this long without selling it to zero gets the hold bonus on dividends. 0 = off.

holdBonusPercent.title: Hold bonus (%)
holdBonusPercent.description: Extra dividend weight for holdings on a hold streak.

travelCommands.title: Travel commands
travelCommands.description: A command counts as travel for travel stocks when its name or trigger contains one of these words. Empty = every command counts.

historyLength.title: Price history length
historyLength.description: How many past prices the stock command shows.

permissions.description: Allows marketadmin (fees in, dividends out, money in the market).
Lowers the trade fee by the count in percent (count 50 = half fee).
Max shares per stock for this player (count). Overrides the config value.

market.description: List all stocks with price and last move.
market.helpText: Shows every stock, its price and its last move.

stock.helpText: stock <ticker>: price, range, what moves it, recent prices and your holding.

buy.helpText: buy <ticker> <shares>: buy shares at the current price plus the fee.

sell.helpText: sell <ticker> <shares|all>: sell at the current price minus the fee.

portfolio.helpText: Shows your holdings, their value, profit, sell locks and hold streaks.

marketadmin.helpText: Fees in, dividends out, fee pool, money in the market, top holders, activity signals (STOCK_ADMIN).

on-player-death.description: Counts player deaths for deaths-driven stocks.

on-command-executed.description: Counts teleport commands for travel-driven stocks.

update-prices.description: Moves prices (signals + noise + pull back), then posts news for big moves.

pay-dividends.description: Pays part of the fee pool to shareholders, with a hold-streak bonus.
